title: FE2 Auto player +
features:
Flood GUI (Flood Escape 2)

Auto-play for Flood Escape 2 with a rebuilt interface, a difficulty skip list and Discord webhooks. Originally made from https://github.com/tomatotxt/Flood-GUI
Run it

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeDorel/Flood-GUI/refs/heads/main/FloodGUI.luau"))()

Features

    Auto-Play: plays a recorded run for each map and queues the next one.
    Skip list: tick Easy, Normal (Medium), Hard, Insane, Crazy or Crazy+ and those maps are skipped (your character resets and you re-queue). Defaults to Crazy and Crazy+.
    Webhooks: Discord embeds when a map is completed (with your headshot, coins, gems, level, XP bar, XP to level up and a session summary), when you die, when a map fails to load, and optionally when a map is skipped.
    Auto Collect, walkspeed/jump sliders, noclip, infinite air, air jump, rejoin, and a TAS creator.
    Settings are saved to Flood-GUI/settings.json in your executor's workspace folder. Your webhook URL lives there, so never share that file.

Press J to hide or show the window.
Credits

TAS record and playback by Voiz. Reverse engineering and the original GUI by tomato.txt. Stat tracker concept by Moz. Interface, skip list and webhooks in this version.
